scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n shared,engine,server,web -c gray,magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w packages/engine" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:packages && npm run build:demo -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run lint -w apps/server && npm run lint -w apps/web
